name: Kettlebell Library
description: Every standalone kettlebell workout in one place, with no schedule. Grab whichever fits the time and the mood: the flows first, then the conditioning blocks, full-body sessions, and the split and short ones. The optional KB days in Functional Bulk stay where they are.
creator: WOD

overview.goal: A menu of kettlebell sessions to pull from, whatever the week looks like.
overview.whatToExpect: The list runs in four groups: flows and complexes (the bell stays in your hands), conditioning (short and hard), full-body sessions, and split or short work (legs, upper, core, finishers). The minutes in each name are the whole session.
keyPrinciples: 1. Flows and complexes: smooth beats fast. The bell stays in your hands and each move hands off to the next.
2. Conditioning: fifteen minutes or less, so pick it on a day when the legs and grip are fresh.
3. Full-body sessions: the ones to repeat. Add reps or weight a little each time you run one.
4. Split and short: legs, upper and core work to bolt onto another session.

tips: No schedule — pick whatever you feel like.
Heavy Doubles needs two bells of equal weight.
Flows run one side, then the other.

schedule.label: Bent Press Flow · 15m
schedule.notes: Dead clean, squat, lateral lunge, bent press, tactical clean. One side, then the other.

schedule.label: Leggy Flow · 15m
schedule.notes: Bent Press Flow's lower-body cousin: dead clean, curtsy and lateral lunges, lateral squat clean, tactical clean.

schedule.label: B-Stance Flow · 25m
schedule.notes: B-stance swing, swing clean, B-stance squat, split stance snatch, overhead lunge. 5 reps a side, 5 rounds.

schedule.label: Outside Snatch Flow · 16m
schedule.notes: The most overhead-loaded flow here: figure 8 into a rack, transverse lunge, then the bell overhead four ways.

schedule.label: Dead Cluster Flow · 14m
schedule.notes: Ballistic, overhead cousin of the Leggy Flow: dead cluster, snatch, iron cross, outside pendulum, tactical clean, reverse lunge, offset rack squat.

schedule.label: Kickstand 5-4-3-2 · 15m
schedule.notes: One arm, bell never down: 5 kickstand rows, 4 step-together cleans, 3 strict presses, 2 snatches. Switch sides.

schedule.label: Figure-8 to Tactical Clean · 25m
schedule.notes: Single-bell hand-switch complex: the figure-8 pass exits into a clean to rack, then a tactical clean back.

schedule.label: Long Coordination Gauntlet · 15m
schedule.notes: Fourteen chained moves on one side, then the other. Swings, cleans, overhead work, lateral and curtsy lunges.

schedule.label: Overhead Mobility Complex · 15m
schedule.notes: Row, snatch, overhead lunge, overhead squat, push press. 5 rounds, 5 reps a side.

schedule.label: Light Flow · 20m
schedule.notes: Light bell, higher reps, short rest. Movement quality and active recovery.

schedule.label: Brutal Complex · 15m
schedule.notes: Swing, squat, row, push-up, 10 reps each, 4 rounds. Bell stays in your hands between moves.

schedule.label: Cardio Complex · 20m
schedule.notes: Row, clean, squat, snatch, 6 reps each side, 5 rounds. One lighter bell.

schedule.label: Conditioning Blast · 15m
schedule.notes: Swings, cleans, snatches, thrusters, fast. Pairs with a rower or treadmill for a 30 min session.

schedule.label: 9-Minute AMRAP · 12m
schedule.notes: Ballistic row, thruster, reverse lunge with knee drive, no rest. As many rounds as possible in 9 minutes.

schedule.label: Four-Move Circuit · 15m
schedule.notes: Pass to squat, reverse lunge to knee drive, snatch, press to march. A circuit, each move on its own clock.

schedule.label: 100 Rep Daily Challenge · 30m
schedule.notes: 100 reps of each of 6 moves with a light bell. Each block has variants so it stays fresh.

schedule.label: The Only KB Workout · 35m
schedule.notes: Swings, clean-to-squats, chest press, Turkish get-ups. Repeatable; progress with weight or reps.

schedule.label: Beginner Full Body · 20m
schedule.notes: One bell, four exercises, full body.

schedule.label: Beginner Strength Builder · 35m
schedule.notes: Swings, squats, presses, rows, 5 rounds.

schedule.label: Athletic Alternating · 20m
schedule.notes: Everything alternates: cleans, squats, presses, plus core. Finishes with offset push-ups on the bell.

schedule.label: Full Body Circuit · 40m
schedule.notes: All major muscle groups, single bell, moderate weight.

schedule.label: Full Body Shred · 40m
schedule.notes: Squat, hinge, push, pull, unilateral and core, heavier on lower body.

schedule.label: Random Circuit · 30m
schedule.notes: Randomized exercises across all the movement patterns. Shuffle for a fresh one.

schedule.label: Heavy Doubles · 35m
schedule.notes: Two bells of equal weight. Heavier loads, lower reps, longer rest.

schedule.label: Legs Circuit · 25m
schedule.notes: Quad and glute focused, with classic KB leg work.

schedule.label: Athletic Lunge Variations · 15m
schedule.notes: Lunge clean-to-press, split pass thrust, lunge snatch, step-back swings.

schedule.label: Upper Body Circuit · 25m
schedule.notes: Push, pull and press with a single bell. Shoulders, back, pressing strength.

schedule.label: Overhead Halo Pyramid · 8m
schedule.notes: Light bell. Overhead tricep extension into a halo, one more rep each round. Warm-up or finisher.

schedule.label: Core Library · 15m
schedule.notes: Russian twists, windmills, halos, side bends, swings. A core finisher, or pick your own circuit.

schedule.label: Daily Controlled Power · 15m
schedule.notes: 50 circles plus 60 reps of swings, pulls and squats. No running, no jumping.
